articles.title: CX Midnight Aurora

From a distance: A mid-tone teal-green with purple undertone and a slight shimmer; it reads as a muted blue-green metallic, not black. Measured spec (average): metal 120, roughness 91, coat 101. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.

Hood and roof: wide panels show the two-tone shimmer
